overview: The committee edited and approved the Medford City Council newsletter for October 2024 and received an update on the status of a new Human Rights Commission ordinance.

items.title: October 2024 City Council Newsletter
items.summary: Approved the draft monthly newsletter after reviewing committee descriptions, incorporating grammatical edits from members, and adding a commemoration for Larry Lepore.

items.title: Human Rights Commission Ordinance Update
items.summary: Kept the matter in committee after receiving an update that a draft ordinance is currently under review by the Mayor and the Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion Director.
